author: agent:claude-code
message: The no_std path is built: the intent now says what it actually leaves behind std (ode compiles without it; streams don't), and that the lean feature set waits on geometry. Building until CI's new no-std job passes on GitHub; then done. (proposal 01a10ade-f939-738b-85a1-71fcaa55d4b1, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

text: One crate, two paths: the default `std` feature as today, and without it core + alloc, float maths through libm (units::float_math), compile-time target features in place of runtime CPU detection, lookup tables through a race-once cell (units::lazy) and no per-thread caches. flux, gpu, and linalg / systems (faer) stay behind std, as do streams over std::io. CI builds the no_std path for wasm32 and runs the tests and clippy on both. A lean feature set (units, simd, geometry) that compiles only those modules comes with geometry (todo).
